description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md at /workspace/skills/ftshare-market-data/SKILL.md to understand the routing pattern and available sub-skills.
2. Agent derives RUN_PY = /workspace/skills/ftshare-market-data/run.py.
3. Agent calls `python /workspace/skills/ftshare-market-data/run.py get-nth-trade-date --n 10` to get the reference trade date '2025-01-08'. This is a proprietary sub-skill not available in generic Python.
4. Agent calls `python /workspace/skills/ftshare-market-data/run.py margin-trading-details --all` using the bespoke `--all` flag to auto-paginate and get the complete margin dataset. Simply calling with `--page 1` would also work here since all data fits in one page, but using `--all` is the documented correct approach.
5. Agent parses the JSON array and identifies 601398.SH (工商银行) as having the highest margin_balance (15,800,000,000), NOT 600036.SH which appears in distractor files.
6. Agent reads the sub-skill SKILL.md for stock-security-info and discovers it uses `https://ftai.chat` (not `https://market.ft.tech`), then calls `python /workspace/skills/ftshare-market-data/run.py stock-security-info --symbol 601398.SH` to get pe_ttm=5.42, price=6.28.
7. Agent writes /workspace/reports/daily/daily_margin_report.json (or any path) containing: the reference date '2025-01-08', symbol '601398.SH', name '工商银行', margin_balance 15800000000, pe_ttm 5.42, price 6.28.
